oauthClientsDescription: This entry registers only Platform local routes; it does not load a dynamic Remote.
platformOverviewDescription: The current session was restored or signed in through the Platform authentication Runtime.
currentSessionScope: This describes identity and authorization for this request only. It does not guarantee a future session refresh.
currentSessionRetryHint: Retry, or sign in again if the session has ended.
currentSessionDenied: These credentials cannot read a Platform identity.
tenantsDescription: Read authoritative status or verify your creation attempts.
tenantCreateDescription: A new Tenant starts pending initialization. Unsubmitted forms are not saved.
tenantNameError: Enter a name between 1 and 200 characters.
tenantUnknownHint: A lost response or cancellation does not mean creation failed. Read server-side creation records before creating again.
tenantReadHint: Retry the read. A failed read does not mean the resource is missing.
tenantNotFound: Tenant not found. Verify the identifier.
tenantExpiryHint: The new Tenant has no expiry. This page creates the Tenant; initialization is a separate step.
quotaDefinitionsDescription: Find and reuse the unique max_users quota definition.
quotaReadHint: Check your platform permissions or retry. A failed read does not mean the definition is absent.
quotaActiveHint: Active and available for plan configuration.
quotaUnknownHint: Read your operation records to verify the outcome. Do not submit again.
quotaCreateDescription: Only the globally unique max_users is supported. Activate after creation; reuse an existing definition.
quotaPendingGuard: An earlier operation needs verification. Read operation records to continue it or verify the outcome.
planDefinitionsDescription: Find, create and activate single-quota plans.
planReadHint: Check your platform permissions or retry. A failed read does not mean the definition is absent.
planActiveHint: Active and available for new Tenants.
planUnknownHint: Read your operation records to verify the outcome. Do not submit again.
planCreateDescription: New plans require max_users of at least 1 and must be activated.
planPendingGuard: An earlier operation needs verification. Read operation records to continue it or verify the outcome.
planLegacyZero: Historical zero quota: ineligible for new grants; existing entitlements are unchanged.
planDefinitionRequired: An ACTIVE max_users definition is required
planDefinitionReady: Using the ACTIVE max_users quota definition.
planInvalid: Use a 2–63 character lowercase code starting with a letter, a 1–200 character name, and an integer limit from 1 to 2147483647.
subscriptionReadHint: Tenant information is retained. Subscription and usage cannot be confirmed; retry this section.
subscriptionIneligible: This Tenant is not eligible for an initial subscription.
subscriptionPlansFailed: Available Plans could not be read
subscriptionRecoveryFailed: Pending subscription records could not be read
subscriptionPendingGuard: An original operation is unresolved. Read its record below and continue it; do not create again.
subscriptionNoPlans: No positive-quota ACTIVE Plan is available. Create and activate a Plan first.
subscriptionDateInvalid: Enter a valid future date and time with a time zone.
subscriptionExpiryHint: Leave the end time empty for no expiry, or enter a date and time with a time zone. Persisted ACTIVE does not mean valid forever.
subscriptionUnknownHint: A failed request does not prove it was not committed. Read the original operation record; do not create again if its outcome cannot be confirmed after retention.
initializationProcessing: Initialization is processing. Reload progress instead of submitting again.
initializationRecoveryRequired: Automatic recovery paused. The original initiator may continue this attempt.
initializationCompensating: Releasing reserved quota. Wait for compensation to complete.
initializationRetryRequired: Compensation completed. A new initialization attempt is allowed.
initializationHistorical: This historical relationship was established at first activation. It is not the current administrator set.
initializationNotification: Initialization and password setup notification are separate. Delivery status was not queried; email delivery is not confirmed.
initializationSubscriptionRequired: Read and confirm an effective subscription before initializing.
initializationUnknownHint: The request may have committed. Reload progress; cancellation or leaving the page does not revoke server work.
initializationInputInvalid: Enter a valid email (up to 320 characters) and a display name up to 200 characters.
